articles.description: Center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong won the National League Platinum Glove award Friday while the Chicago Cubs took home the team Gold Glove award.

articles.description: On Nov. 2, 2016 — 10 years ago Monday — the Chicago Cubs ended the longest title drought in North American sports history by winning the World Series.
articles.title: ‘Everyone can die happy’: 10 years later, Chicago Cubs’ 2016 World Series title still resonates

articles.description: Chicago Cubs’ Pete Crow-Armstrong and Alex Bregman won NL Gold Glove Awards, while three finalist teammates fell short of the honor.
articles.title: Chicago Cubs’ Pete Crow-Armstrong and Alex Bregman win Gold Glove Awards

articles.description: New Seattle Mariners manager Jason Kanzler was the Chicago Cubs director of player development, leading their minor-league system, players and coaching staff.
articles.title: Seattle Mariners hire Jason Kanzler, the Chicago Cubs farm director, as their new manager

articles.title: Column: Raucous Milwaukee Brewers celebration reminds Chicago Cubs fans of their fleeting moment in the sun

articles.description: The Chicago Cubs added to their pitching depth Monday by claiming right-hander Eric Orze, an Elk Grove native and Glenbard North graduate, off waivers from the Minnesota Twins.
articles.title: Chicago Cubs begin the offseason by extending a qualifying offer to right fielder Seiya Suzuki
